answer_2.quote: To evaluate this quality, BLEU and ROUGE-L (Lin, 2004) are also reported. Note, however, that these two measures are based on simple string matches which, in many cases, are not good indicators of output quality. To counteract this problem, we also report results with METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005) -which uses stemming and WordNet synonyms and BERTScore, which uses vector-based contextual similarities.
